answer: Stake-backed reputation is a concrete Sybil defence: an agent must lock a refundable deposit and complete publicly auditable work before it gains voting or reward weight. New identities begin on a narrow ledge with almost no influence, so creating thousands of fakes means paying thousands of deposits and doing real work for each one, and cheating forfeits the stake. Genuine history accrues slowly, like a pearl forming layer by layer, whereas a sable marker for audited, long-lived agents makes cheap copies stand out at a glance.
